title: applied-ml-weekly-research-notes-2026-02-27
content:
Week: 2026-02-24 to 2026-02-28 - Applied ML research sync (quantization, evals, model onboarding)

Overview:
- This doc captures our weekly standups, meeting notes, and quick experiment logs for quantization and onboarding of community models (primarily Orca-7B and Mistral-8x). Focus areas: reduce memory and token latency via int4/int8 quant, verify eval regressions, and streamline onboarding checklist for Private/Dedicated.
- Status: working drafts of quant profiles and eval harness added to repo; initial 4-bit experiment shows ~2.6x memory reduction vs fp16 but a soft regression on long-form coherence at >1k tokens for Orca.

Daily standups (short):
- Mon 2026-02-24: Maya - defined quantization matrix for target models; created experiment tracker (sheet). Diego - baseline eval runs for Orca-7B fp16 and int8. Priya - started integration of eval scripts into CI. Evan - profiling token-by-token latency on A100 and H100.
- Tue 2026-02-25: Maya - ran first QAT-lite for Orca int4; noticed KV-cache mismatch with current runtime patch. Diego - re-ran evals with fresh KV-cache fix, results attached. Priya - expanded eval set with 3 prompt families (summarization, code, dialogue).
- Wed 2026-02-26: Sync meeting notes below ("Quant & Onboarding sync"). Evan - collected memory/throughput numbers for dedicated config. Samira - drafted onboarding checklist for Private (networking, KMS, model artifacts).
- Thu 2026-02-27: Diego - started long-context evals (1k, 2k, 4k tokens). Early signal: int4 has drift after ~1.2k tokens on story-coherence metric. Maya - tuning per-layer scale strategy (GPTQ-style) gave small improvements.
- Fri 2026-02-28: Wrap-up: consolidated metrics and action items. Laid out plan for next-week ablation (per-layer vs per-group, entropy-based clipping).

Meeting: Quant & Onboarding sync (Wed 2026-02-26) - attendees: Maya, Diego, Priya, Evan, Samira
- Agenda: experiment progress, KV-cache compatibility, eval regressions, onboarding checklist gaps, next-week experiments.
- Notes:
  - KV-cache: identified that our runtime's KV layout differs for int4 packing ordering; workaround applied in branch re-runtime/kv-int4-fix. Diego to open PR and add unit tests (JIRA-ML-3489).
  - Quant profiles: Maya presented two candidate profiles: 
    * profile-A: per-layer symmetric int4 w/ minmax clipping + bias-correction
    * profile-B: per-group (128) GPTQ-like with 8-bit outlier handling
    Quick outcome: A is simpler and faster but slightly worse on long-coherence; B is heavier but preserves coherence better.
  - Eval regressions: Priya reported a 3.2% BLEU/ROUGE-equivalent drop on story-coherence for Orca-7B int4 profile-A at 2k tokens; at 512 tokens difference is <0.5%.
  - Onboarding checklist: Samira highlighted missing items for Private customers: artifact signing, model provenance manifest, KMS envelope key tests. Added to checklist doc (linked_artifacts).
  - Action items assigned (see below).

Experiment log (high-level):
- Models tested this week: Orca-7B, Mistral-8x, Redstone-13B (internal).
- Configs: fp16 baseline, int8 dynamic, int4 symmetric, int4 GPTQ-style (per-group).
- Hardware: A100-40GB, H100-80GB, Dedicated inference config (2xA100 w/ tensor cores).

Key numbers (summary):
- Orca-7B (fp16): mem=12.4GB, p50_token_latency=12ms (A100), perplexity-baseline on short evals = 18.2
- Orca-7B (int8): mem=7.6GB, p50_token_latency=9ms, perplexity ~18.5 (negligible)
- Orca-7B (int4 profile-A): mem=4.7GB, p50_token_latency=7.5ms, coherence-drop @2k=~3.2%
- Mistral-8x (int8): mem=10.2GB, latency ~11ms; int4 experiments ongoing (profiling).
- Throughput: batching improvements + int4 => 1.8-2.2x throughput vs fp16 for same GPU memory envelope.

Mini-analysis and hypotheses:
- The long-context coherence regression in int4 likely stems from quantization error accumulation in attention key/values — hypothesis: group-wise scale instability for high-variance tokens (punctuation, rare tokens).
- Another hypothesis: our KV-cache packing reorder for int4 introduces tiny misalignment when stitching cached segments >512 tokens; needs strict unit tests.
- Early fixes: per-layer rescaling and entropy-based clipping reduces regressions by ~1% but not fully remediate.

Onboarding checklist status (Samira draft):
- Required: model artifact (hf format), checksum + signed manifest, model card, license verification.
- Infra: container image, runtime config (quant profile), benchmark script, eval prompts.
- Security: KMS envelope test, audit logging hooks, network egress policy.
- Testing: short/long context evals, perf profile, canary rollout plan for Dedicated/Private.
- Missing: automated provenance signing and a simple local encryption test harness.

Open issues / blockers:
- KV-cache int4 packing bug (blocking some long-context runs) - blocker for canary on Dedicated.
- Missing automated artifact signing pipeline for Private onboarding (security review pending).
- Need more systematic evals for hallucination/instability under int4 for code generation prompts.

Action items (owners):
- Diego: open PR for KV-cache int4 fix + unit tests (JIRA-ML-3489) - due 2026-03-04.
- Maya: run ablation (per-layer vs per-group) for Orca-7B int4 and log results in sheet - due 2026-03-05.
- Priya: expand eval harness to include hallucination metrics for code and long-dialogue; wire into CI (PR 1286 referenced).
- Evan: produce a short perf doc comparing Dedicated configs (1xA100 vs 2xA100) for target throughput SLOs - due 2026-03-06.
- Samira: finalize onboarding checklist and prototype artifact signing flow; sync with security team - due 2026-03-09.

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Consider adding temp per-token error logging in runtime for int4 to collect where quant errors spike; sampling rate 1/1000 tokens in prod tests.
- Evaluate fallback policy: serve int8 for requests >1k tokens, int4 for <1k to avoid coherence regressions while preserving cost benefits. Need to try hybrid routing policy in runtime.
- Possible quick win: deploy profile-A for smaller workloads and profile-B for long-context customers as a routing rule.

PRs / Tickets referenced this week:
- github.com/redwood-inference/re-runtime/pull/1286 (eval harness CI integration)
- JIRA-ML-3489 (KV-cache int4 packing bug)
- JIRA-ML-3421 (Onboarding: artifact signing requirement)

Next week (plan):
- Complete ablation experiments and decide on default quant profile for Orca-7B.
- Implement KV-cache unit tests and merge fix.
- Prototype hybrid routing policy (int4 for <1k tokens by default).
- Begin secure artifact signing prototype and draft customer-facing onboarding checklist.

Appendix (quick experiment notes):
- Orca-7B int4 profile-A: eval run id qrun-20260226-A -> metrics stored in sheets/quant-experiments-feb26, approx 3.2% coherence drop at 2k.
- Orca-7B per-group GPTQ (profile-B) trial qrun-20260227-B -> slightly higher memory (5.6GB) but coherence closer to fp16; slower inference (~+15% latency).

If you want a boiled down version for the weekly eng-all: ping me and I can make a 1-slide summary with numbers and recommended defaults.

-- maya
